opening.argument: The speaker directs viewers to purchase Bitcoin Cash and send it to designated wallets in order to buy Bitcoin and GPU mining packages, describing entry at $500 and progression to a $3,500 package. He presents repurchasing as a way to expand mining participation, saying viewers can use proceeds or “at the same time repurchase.” The promotion also connects recruiting purchasers through a link with their later repurchases and promises commissions on both Bitcoin and GPU activity. It further says increased mining power will produce “bigger payouts in your mining pools,” presenting paid participation and reinvestment as the route to additional returns. The records establish the payment instructions, package structure, reinvestment and commission scheme, but do not establish that participants lost funds or that advertised payouts occurred.
